text: それ　いじょう　もちきれない　ですよ！

structure.jp: もちきれない　ですよ！

patterns.name: 〜きれない
patterns.explanation: きれない added to a verb says you cannot do it all the way, because there is too much. もちきれない = 'can't carry it all'.

patterns.name: 〜ないです
patterns.span: もちきれない　ですよ
patterns.explanation: です put after a ない word just makes it polite; the meaning stays the same. もちきれない ですよ = 'you can't carry any more, you know'.
